mapper.insert: insert into learner_profile_evidence (user_id, profile_id, profile_version, dimension_key, source_type, source_ref, excerpt, confidence, evidence_status) values (#{userId}, #{profileId}, #{profileVersion}, #{dimensionKey}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef}, #{excerpt}, #{confidence}, #{evidenceStatus})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, profile_id, profile_version, dimension_key, source_type, source_ref, excerpt, confidence, evidence_status, create_time from learner_profile_evidence where user_id = #{userId} and profile_id = #{profileId} and profile_version = #{profileVersion} order by create_time desc limit 50
